g.text: Synthetic data. (a) Simulated melt-pool emission image of one 7.7 mm × 7.7 mm layer with scan-track texture and three dark flaws; boxes mark pixels more than 4σ
below the local median. (b) 400 simulated flaws per sensor (ticks: hits at 1, misses at 0), contrast reduced by blur of one pixel, detection at 3.5σ; logistic
hit/miss POD fit in log size (MIL-HDBK-1823A style), a90/95 = 95 % bootstrap bound on the size found 90 % of the time.
